verdict.rationale: Paystack's own docs say you can "Retrieve all your transaction and customer data" and offer "easy exports" from the Dashboard, and its paginated list endpoints support bulk retrieval. The evidence never names export formats, never confirms that all data types (beyond transactions and customers) can be exported, and says nothing about account closure. Missing for 10: documented open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), proof of complete coverage of all account data, account deletion/offboarding process, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
